manual_integrations.reason: The local Mac checkout carries render_source_deck(), which the patch baseline does not contain, while BOTH baseline and payload restyle_runner.py import render_source_deck from .render. The payload render.py also drops the local pdf_stem/page_prefix options that render_source_deck depended on. Applying the payload verbatim would therefore raise ImportError at the source render step and would delete an unrelated local capability.

decisions.detail: render_native_candidate is byte-identical to the patch payload, so the patch's own change (impress_pdf_Export ExportHiddenSlides=true) is applied unchanged and the conflicting local hunks in that function are NOT kept.
decisions.superseded_local_change: pdf_stem / page_prefix options of render_native_candidate. They existed only so that render_source_deck could name its artifacts; they had no other caller in the repo (grep over src/, tests/, tools/ returned only restyle_runner.py importing render_source_deck).
decisions.replacement: render_source_deck renames the produced artifacts (candidate.pdf -> source.pdf, page-N.png -> slide-N.png) after the verdict, keeping the capability without editing the patch's renderer.

decisions.detail: render_source_deck() is re-appended at the end of the module. Position is forced: it must stay after the last payload byte so that the installer sees current.startswith(payload) == True and classifies render.py as already_applied_with_local_changes instead of conflicting again.

The local docstring claimed hidden slides are not emitted by the PDF export. After the patch's ExportHiddenSlides change that is false, so the docstring now states hidden slides ARE exported and that expected_page_count must count every slide. restyle_runner already passes len(deck.slides), which counts hidden slides, so the expectation stays consistent.

not_done: conflict check not removed or weakened
no whole-file blind overwrite: payload kept as exact prefix, local function restored on top
no unrelated file touched (git status shows only manifest files plus the installer's own backup dir)
